parts.text: what does it mean by form submit

A form submit is when the browser sends a form to a server and reloads the page.

Example: a login page is a form. You type your email, click "Sign in", and the page sends your info to a server. The page usually reloads or moves to a new page.

If your Add button were inside a `<form>` and you forgot `type="button"`, clicking Add would:

1. Send the form to the server
2. Reload the page
3. Reset your total back to 0

You don't want that. You want the click to just run JavaScript and update the total.

So `type="button"` tells the browser: "No, this is not a submit button. Don't reload. Just sit there and let my JS handle it."

In your Pixel Cafe there is no `<form>`, so the browser won't submit anyway. But adding `type="button"` is a good habit. It makes your buttons safe to move into a form later.
